home.meta_title: Bathroom and Kitchen Remodels, Delta and Jackson | AKM
home.meta_description: Full bathroom and kitchen remodels in the Mississippi Delta, Madison, Ridgeland, Jackson and Oxford. Clear plan and labor cost first. Free estimates.
home.hero_headline: Turn your house into your forever home
home.hero_sub: We remodel bathrooms and kitchens across the Mississippi Delta, the Jackson area and Oxford. You get a clear plan and the labor cost up front, and you only pay as each stage is done.
home.problem_heading: A remodel shouldn't feel like a gamble
problem: You want a bathroom or kitchen you're proud of. What worries you is the contractor: a price that keeps climbing, or a crew that disappears with the room torn apart.
You shouldn't have to hand over your savings and hope it works out.
home.guide_heading: We built AKM around those worries
home.guide_empathy: Trusting someone with tens of thousands of dollars and your home is a big step. We earn that trust in ways you can check.
guide_authority: More than 10 years in the trade
Partner plumbers, electricians and concrete crews
home.money_heading: Your money goes to finished work

money_points.title: You pay as each stage is done
money_points.body: We're paid when each part of the job is finished. Your money goes to work you can see, or to materials sitting at your house.

money_points.title: You see the labor cost up front
money_points.body: We walk you through each choice. If something needs a bigger spend, we tell you why. If there's a way to save, we point it out.

services_teaser.name: Bathrooms
services_teaser.line: Full remodels. Most 5 by 8 bathrooms run $6,000 to $8,000 in labor.

services_teaser.name: Kitchens
services_teaser.line: Full remodels with new cabinets, usually $15,000 to $25,000 before granite.

plan_steps: Ask for a free estimate. Send a few photos of the space.
Get a clear plan with the labor cost spelled out before any work starts.
Pay as each stage is finished, until the job is done.
home.success_heading: A home you'll want to stay in
home.success: A bathroom you're glad to show company. A kitchen that works for the way you cook. And a final bill that matches the plan you agreed to.
home.stakes: Pick the wrong contractor and you can end up paying twice: once for the job, and again to fix it.

about.meta_title: About AKM Real Estate and Construction | Belzoni, MS
about.meta_description: AKM Real Estate and Construction remodels bathrooms and kitchens across the Mississippi Delta, the Jackson area and Oxford. Free estimates.
about.heading: About AKM
about.lead: Most homeowners worry a remodel will run over budget or never get finished. AKM gives you the plan and the labor cost up front, and you pay only as each stage is done.
body: AKM Real Estate and Construction is a remodeling and building company based in Belzoni, Mississippi. We work across the Delta, the Jackson area and Oxford.
We take on full bathroom and kitchen remodels. We don't do handyman work or small repairs.
Partner contractors cover plumbing, electrical and concrete, so one call can cover the whole project.

how.title: A clear plan first
how.body: Before work starts, you know what we'll do, what's possible and why, and what the labor costs.

how.title: Pay as each stage is done
how.body: We're paid when each part of the job is finished, never for work you can't see.

how.title: Materials at cost
how.body: Buy materials yourself and have them delivered, or we pick them up and bill them at what we paid.

how.title: Built to last
how.body: We'd rather tell you a bigger spend is needed, and why, than build something that won't hold up.
